title: Myridia
slogan: When in doubt, use brute force.

columns.heading: Welcome to the real world
paragraphs: Cyberspace is much more than what you can find from an Apple Store. We reclaim it for the people, putting people first and letting borders sit where they serve real needs. The network is not a thing to be owned; it is a thing to be shared.

We believe in a revolution that is iterative, open, and civil. Build free software, keep markets open, and let knowledge travel as freely as the medium that carries it. When in doubt, use brute force — and share what you find.
This site is a notebook of ideas, a laboratory for free thought, and a record of the information epoch. Everything here is generated from plain JSON — one page, one document, no hidden strings.
Search anything, read deeply, and take the ideas wherever they lead. The world is a continuous medium; our job is to stop treating it like a set of walls.
